questions.correct_answer: For M06 decision 5, recommend against. The protected bound is 266 x 0.72 = 191.5/s, and the planned 234.1/s exceeds that bound, so the proposal has no reserve for the condition the exercise is protecting. Reversal conditions: a repeated measurement showing protected capacity above 234.1/s, a narrower failure assumption with evidence, or an explicit policy that sheds at least 42.6/s of lower-priority work.
questions.explanation: M06-Q040 turns on the forcing number from EX-05, not preference; the reversal conditions are specific to the measured gap in this prompt.
questions.grading_notes: Full credit gives the recommendation, the forcing number, and a concrete reversal condition; half credit for a recommendation with no measurable reversal evidence.
